# Ceq

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human/product overview when present.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context when present.
- `docs/README.md` — documentation map, precedence, and current truth layer.
- `docs/CEQ_CODEBASE_AUDIT_WRAPUP_2026-06-02.md` — latest audit wrap-up and ROI-prioritized blockers.
- `docs/DOCS_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_2026-06-02.md` — current repo/prod evidence audit and remaining unverified claims.
- `docs/CEQ_IDENTITY_AND_DEMO_WRAPUP.md` — session wrap-up, doc index, operator gates.
- `docs/CEQ_STABILITY_ROADMAP.md` — **Pending work (current)** section first: the one list of open engineering items and owner decisions; then stabilization phases, smoke matrix, remaining gates.
- `docs/GA_DEMO_DEFINITION.md` — capped GA demo definition, readiness scorecard, Tier A/B/C.
- `docs/COMMERCIAL_GA_REMEDIATION_PLAN.md` — paid launch gates, remediation tracks, commercial GA declaration criteria.
- `docs/COMMERCIAL_LAUNCH_READINESS_PACK.md` — launch evidence, support macros, alert/legal readiness checklist.
- `docs/JANUA_OPERATOR.md` — Janua OAuth registration checklist (Phase 0 operator gate).
- `docs/JANUA_AGENT_HANDOFF.md` — complete cross-repo handoff for Janua-side agents.
- `docs/PLATFORM_AGENT_HANDOFFS.md` — orchestrator + Vault/K8s/acceptance agent prompts.
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.

## Stack

- Studio (`apps/studio`): Next.js 15.5.27, React 19.3, pnpm 9.14.4, standalone output started by `server-entry.mjs`.
- API / workers: FastAPI / Python 3.11.

## Testing and CI gates

- Studio unit tests: `pnpm --filter @ceq/studio test`
- Studio Playwright auth E2E: `pnpm --filter @ceq/studio test:e2e` (mock Janua server)
- Studio standalone header smoke: `scripts/studio-standalone-header-smoke.sh` (after the studio build; includes `/_next/image` → 404)
- Studio Docker smoke: `scripts/studio-docker-smoke.sh <image>` (reads the container log once; never `docker logs | grep -q` under pipefail)
- Security invariant: Studio image optimizer off in all envs (`images.unoptimized`, exact `remotePatterns`, GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4); guarded by `apps/studio/__tests__/next-config-images.test.ts` and both smokes
- Runners: GitHub-hosted jobs pinned to `ubuntu-24.04`
- Public production smoke: `CEQ_PUBLIC_ONLY=true scripts/production-smoke.sh`
- CI jobs: `Studio · Docker smoke`, `Studio · Playwright auth` (see `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`)

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.
